visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Quantity field takes any text
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Phones show a letter keyboard for this quantity field, and the browser accepts the word "many". The field should be a number field that also stops at 10.

solution.explanation: type="number" restricts the value to numbers, shows a numeric keypad and makes min and max work. A text input ignores min and max, so any word is accepted.

checks.label: The quantity is a number input
A value above 10 is not valid
